notes.title: Chat interaction on Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok!
notes.content:
Play Mega Quiz Gaming with Chat Integration on Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok!

Looking for games to play with your Twitch chat? Or maybe games to play with your YouTube chat?
Mega Quiz Gaming now supports full chat integration across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok Live, making it the perfect game for streamers who want to engage their community in real time.

Whether you're streaming on Twitch or TikTok, Mega Quiz Gaming lets your viewers help you or compete to guess answers live during your stream.
It’s ideal for creators searching for:

Games for Twitch chat interaction

Games to play with your YouTube chat

Chat integration with Kick live stream chat

Games that use TikTok Live chat

No bots, no complicated setup—just plug in your stream and start playing with your audience instantly.
Turn your broadcast into a fun, competitive, and highly interactive experience with Mega Quiz Gaming!

Play together, stream together. Available now for Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok.

notes.title: Full version is out!
notes.content:
We have added a lot of content to the game!

- 920 levels of silhouettes, classified by thematic packs.
- New help system for emoji levels, indicating the type of guess it is.
- Maximum number of clues increased to 40 clues, which will be reloaded every 45 seconds.
- Every 30 minutes, even with the game closed, all clues will be reloaded.
- All game descriptions are unlocked for free.
- Improved system for connection to your Tiktok Live chat.
